FAQ

Security questions. Answered.

Didn't find your answer? Email contact@medicoder.ai or book a call.

How is my data protected?

Every note is encrypted in transit — from your browser to MediCoder — and at rest wherever it's stored. You also choose exactly which notes to upload; nothing connects to your EHR.

Is it HIPAA compliant?

Yes. MediCoder.AI is HIPAA compliant, every note is encrypted in transit and at rest, and a BAA is available.

Will you sign a BAA?

Yes. A Business Associate Agreement is available — email contact@medicoder.ai or book a call to set one up.

Do I need an EHR integration?

No. Upload notes from any EHR, in any format — PDFs, text or dictation exports, as a single note or a batch.
